rationale: Clear motor vehicle collision with totaled vehicle and bodily injury to the policyholder as a result of the accident.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15am by a vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph with no braking. The vehicle is totaled with severe trunk and back-seat damage. Claimant sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information.

case_facts.description: rear-end collision; other driver going approximately 35 mph, no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: yes; other driver's insurance info included
